issues.issue: What standard of review applies to the Agency's interpretation of the provisions defining its jurisdiction?
issues.applicant_position: Correctness applies because the question concerns the Agency's jurisdiction under the definitions.
issues.respondent_position: Reasonableness applies, following Via Rail; the Agency interprets its home statute.
issues.result_quote: It follows that this Court is bound to apply the standard of review applied in Via Rail, which is reasonableness.

issues.issue: Are the pipeline portions beside the tracks a utility crossing within the Agency's jurisdiction under s. 101(3)?
issues.applicant_position: "Over or under a railway line" means track only; valves beside the track are outside the definition.
issues.respondent_position: "Railway line" includes the right of way, so the pipeline on it is a utility crossing; the Agency's reading is reasonable.
issues.result_quote: In my view, the Agency’s interpretation of the definition of “utility line” is reasonable. I see no basis for the intervention of this Court.
